# NANO Faucet

> nano.lol.my.id is a free, anonymous Nano faucet. One spin every 45 minutes pays XNO, XDG (DogeNano), or BAN (Banano) directly to the wallet address saved in the browser.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nano.lol.my.id/): overview, features, and source links.
- [Faucet](https://nano.lol.my.id/#faucet): connect a wallet and spin the reward reel.
- [Referrals](https://nano.lol.my.id/#referrals): referral link, referral stats, and 20% earnings.

## How it works

- Save a supported wallet address: `nano_`, `xdg_`, or `ban_`.
- One free spin is available per address every 45 minutes.
- After a successful spin, the payout is sent to the wallet automatically.
- Card brightness on the reel shows the payout tier. The blue card is the top prize.
- Referrers earn 20% of the rewards paid to wallets they refer.

## Source

- [Frontend](https://github.com/lol-my-id/nano-faucet)
- [Backend](https://github.com/lol-my-id/nano-faucet-backend)

## Notes

- No account, email address, personal information, or KYC is required.
- The wallet address is stored locally in the browser.
- Rewards are intentionally small. This is a faucet, not an exchange or casino.
